edits.hypothesis: Strengthen the followup LLM prompt to explicitly request ANSWER: format output, forcing the LLM to structure its final answer in an extractable form even when computation results are available and should be used.
edits.targets_mode: output_format_mismatch (evolve-numeric-002): LLM has tool output but returns narrative explanation instead of structured answer
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instruction in followup prompt is the direct mechanism by which harness can shape LLM's output format; reordering control flow to make format enforcement happen at the point where tool output is being grounded is more reliable than a distant system prompt guideline
edits.trigger_condition: Fires whenever tool_output exists (code was successfully executed) and followup LLM call is made; enforces ANSWER: format in that critical moment when LLM should be synthesizing tool results
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-numeric-002 failed because final output was 'The ledger shows a negative balance...' instead of '-183764'; explicit ANSWER: format request would force LLM to restructure its synthesis; (preservative) passing tasks (000, 001, 003, 004, 009, 010) all successfully use tool output and would benefit from or remain unharmed by stricter format guidance; (transfer) any numeric task where LLM correctly computes but formats narratively will benefit; generalizes to other answer-extraction domains
edits.regression_risk: LLM might output 'ANSWER: -183764' exactly as requested but risk remains minimal since extraction logic (C2) handles both ANSWER: and narrative formats as fallback
edits.mechanism: Strengthen the followup LLM prompt to explicitly request ANSWER: format output, forcing the LLM to structure its final answer in an extractable form even when computation results are available and should be used.

edits.hypothesis: Add robust answer extraction that looks for ANSWER: format line before falling back to last line, ensuring numeric answers embedded in structured format are correctly isolated even if narrative text follows.
edits.targets_mode: output_extraction robustness: current harness blindly returns last line; if LLM outputs 'ANSWER: -183764' followed by any narrative, harness must extract the ANSWER: line, not the narrative
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Extraction logic is harness-level plumbing that cannot be influenced by prompts; must be implemented in code to guarantee correct answer is returned to grader
edits.trigger_condition: Activates on every solve() call for any LLM response; preferentially extracts ANSWER: format if present (enabled by C1), falls back to last line (preserving current behavior when ANSWER: absent)
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-numeric-002 failed because grader received narrative; if LLM outputs ANSWER: -183764 followed by explanatory text, this extraction ensures -183764 is returned; (preservative) all passing tasks continue to work because fallback to last line is preserved; ANSWER: extraction is purely additive; (transfer) generalizes to any task where LLM correctly identifies answer but embeds it in ANSWER: format with surrounding narrative
edits.regression_risk: None—this is a pure enhancement that adds ANSWER: detection as first priority and preserves original last-line fallback behavior
edits.mechanism: Add robust answer extraction that looks for ANSWER: format line before falling back to last line, ensuring numeric answers embedded in structured format are correctly isolated even if narrative text follows.

edits.hypothesis: Relax markdown code block regex from requiring explicit newline after 'python' to allowing flexible whitespace (````\s*python\s*...```), capturing code blocks that may be formatted with spaces or slight variations in markdown syntax.
edits.targets_mode: tool_invocation_avoidance or unverified_tool_output (evolve-numeric-005): if LLM generates markdown code with atypical spacing (e.g., ```` ``` python ```  or leading spaces), current regex fails silently and tool_output remains empty, forcing LLM to rely on mental arithmetic (resulting in reported sum 414 vs correct 351)
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Regex matching is a harness-level parsing mechanism; cannot be influenced by prompts; must be fixed in code to ensure tool invocations are actually captured when LLM generates them
edits.trigger_condition: Fires only when LLM response contains markdown code blocks; triggers whenever markdown block exists with flexible spacing around 'python' keyword; existing rigid regex would miss these, causing tool_output to be empty and no followup call to occur
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-numeric-005 reported 414 instead of 351 for digit sum; if Python code was generated in markdown but not parsed due to spacing, harness never captured output, LLM never received 'ANSWER: 351' in followup, and mental arithmetic (414) propagated to final answer; relaxing regex ensures code is found and executed; (preservative) existing passing tasks use both XML invoke blocks and markdown code; relaxed regex matches superset of old patterns, so no regression; (transfer) any task where LLM uses nonstandard markdown formatting benefits; improves robustness across code-generation approaches
edits.regression_risk: Regex is strictly more permissive; will match all previously matched patterns plus additional variations, so no valid code blocks are missed; no risk of false positives since pattern still requires opening ``` and closing ```, just allows flexible spacing around 'python' keyword
edits.mechanism: Relax markdown code block regex from requiring explicit newline after 'python' to allowing flexible whitespace (````\s*python\s*...```), capturing code blocks that may be formatted with spaces or slight variations in markdown syntax.

mechanism: Three targeted control-flow edits to enforce and extract ANSWER: format (fixing evolve-numeric-002 output format mismatch) and improve markdown code detection (addressing potential parsing gaps in evolve-numeric-005).
